items.title: ICICI Bank Visa KING Offer 2026: Spend ₹2 Lakh to Meet Bollywood Stars?
items.summary: Register by missed call and spend at least ₹2 lakh on one eligible ICICI Bank Visa credit card from 1 to 30 November 2026. The top 5 spenders get to meet Bollywood stars; the next 500 get two red-carpet screening tickets each.

sources.label: ICICI Bank, campaign terms and conditions (PDF)
Visa India, Shah Rukh Khan partnership announcement
Red Chillies Entertainment, KING film page

offer.value: Top 5 spenders: meet Bollywood stars. Next 500: two red-carpet screening tickets each
offer.minSpend: ₹2,00,000 in eligible retail spends on a single card
offer.eligibility: ICICI Bank Visa credit cardholders who register by missed call on 02269445464; Amazon Pay ICICI Bank cards excluded

items.title: OneCard Festive Bonanza gives extra 2.5% valueback on spends
items.summary: Selected OneCard users get an extra 2.5% valueback on total eligible spends from 25 to 31 October 2026 after a personalised spend target (₹50,000 here). Capped at 15,000 points (₹1,500), credited on 15 December 2026.

image.alt: Two screenshots of the OneCard app's Festive Bonanza offer, 25 to 31 October 2026. Spend ₹50,000 to earn an additional 2.5% valueback up to 15,000 points, credited on 15 December 2026, with the steps and terms and conditions.

sources.label: OneCard (offer and terms shown in the OneCard app)

offer.value: Extra 2.5% valueback on total eligible spends
offer.eligibility: Targeted; only selected OneCard users who received the offer in the app

items.title: HDFC Tata Neu credit cards: NeuCoins must be claimed by hand from 25 November 2026, or they expire
items.summary: From 25 November 2026, NeuCoins earned on Tata Neu HDFC Bank credit cards stop moving to Tata Neu automatically. Claim them in the Tata Neu app (minimum 100, up to 3 claims a day) within 12 months of the statement, or they expire.

image.alt: HDFC Bank email to Tata Neu HDFC Bank Credit Card holders saying that from 25 November 2026 Tata NeuCoins must be claimed through the Tata Neu app, can be claimed within 12 months of the statement date and stay valid for 12 more months after claiming, and are no longer credited automatically

sources.label: HDFC Bank, Tata NeuCoins claim and redemption process (PDF)

items.title: PNB credit card charges rise from 1 November 2026: utility fee, ₹99 redemption fee, higher late fees
items.summary: From 1 November 2026, PNB charges 1% on utility payments above ₹50,000 a cycle, ₹99 + GST per reward redemption, and late fees of up to ₹1,200 (was ₹750). Applies to PNB Visa and RuPay cards.

sources.label: PNB public notice, revision in service charges on credit cards (PDF)

items.title: PNB credit cards give up to ₹1,500 cashback for Navratri and Dussehra
items.summary: Make at least 3 transactions of ₹9,999 on a PNB credit card between 11 and 20 October 2026 to get cashback of up to ₹1,500, once per card. Co-branded cards are excluded.

image.alt: PNB Credit Card Navratri and Dussehra cashback campaign poster showing 10% cashback, a minimum order value of ₹9,999, maximum cashback of ₹1,500 and a campaign period of 11 to 20 October 2026

sources.label: PNB Navratri offer terms and conditions

offer.eligibility: PNB credit cards; co-branded cards are excluded

items.title: Slice Business Credit Card launches in December 2026
items.summary: Slice’s business card for sole proprietors is due in December 2026. Pre-launch material promises no annual fee, up to 2% cashback and zero forex markup; the full terms aren’t out yet.
